title: Consolidate coordinators and move complete modules
goal: Implement the fixed ownership map for Scopes, Audit and DevTools while preserving one decision/write path and keeping Filament on neutral core contracts.
context: Architecture phase C. Approximate size: L. Namespace/DSL changes follow the already chosen transition map; durable data does not change. Complete slices include providers, configuration, health, commands, schema and generated stubs. Task decomposition is deferred.

consumes: The chosen API/SPI and upgrade map from the preceding phase
produces: Explicit module autoload roots and optional activation boundaries
One internal authority-read coordinator and coherent source preparation
Transactional Audit participation with one core event-value construction
Compiled consumer/generator fixtures using supported symbols
boundaries: No core-to-module, sibling-to-sibling or extension-to-internal references
No inactive-module I/O or compulsory optional tables
Preserve physical-handle snapshots, bounded read retries and root-commit publication

include: Source preparation, PanelRegistry/compiler and metadata fingerprints
Directories, Schema, service providers, console commands and Filament consumers
exclude: Physical extraction into new Composer products
Feature expansion or relaxed exact-query semantics
Exposing internal database mechanisms as public SPI

pitfalls: Moving the plugin alone leaves schema/config/health/provider dependencies in core
Application-wide evaluator/options bindings leak between panels
Audit must receive the exact core event IDs inside the transaction
Read retries must not repeat policies/hooks or lose original subject model instances

validation.procedure: Run a core isolation fixture with optional module autoload roots absent; test each activation combination and two panels with different module options; prove scalar/batch/SQL and assignment/directory/write parity, rollback/retry/event-ID equality, physical-handle release and disposable cache fingerprint behavior.
validation.expect: All scenarios preserve existing semantics and data; optional modules add no work when inactive and all consumers use the chosen supported surface.

deliverables: Final ownership/dependency map and module activation matrix
Updated supported-surface consumer and generator fixtures

sections.title: Exit criterion
sections.text: The target boundaries exist in code, including every composition root and resource owner. Core boots/checks/writes without optional module roots, and all supported paths agree on authority.
